Entries.ascension_mine_letter: Hey @, I hear you’ve become quite familiar with the pelican town mines, up for something a little more dangerous. Join the Ascension Expedition to the mountains to experience stardew valley at its Coldest. Come to the mountains northwest of the farm when ready.^Joseph%item quest StartingQuest true %%
